name: Complete checkout with a single item (happy path)
description: Validates the complete four-stage checkout flow end-to-end for a single-item cart, confirming every stage transition and required page element specified across AC1–AC4.
precondition: Browser session is fresh (not logged in); user has valid credentials; cart is empty.

test_steps.description: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com and log in with `standard_user` / `secret_sauce`
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page)

test_steps.description: Click "Add to cart" for Sauce Labs Backpack
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "1"; button changes to "Remove"

test_steps.description: Click the cart icon to open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page (`cart.html`) lists Sauce Labs Backpack with quantity 1, description, and price $29.99

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html` ("Checkout: Your Information")

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "Jane", Last Name "Smith", Zip "12345", then click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` ("Checkout: Overview")

test_steps.description: Review the Overview page
test_steps.expected_result: Sauce Labs Backpack line item (qty 1, $29.99) is shown; Payment Information "SauceCard #31337" is shown; Shipping Information "Free Pony Express Delivery!" is shown; Item total: $29.99, Tax: $2.40 (8%), Total: $32.39

test_steps.description: Click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; heading "Thank you for your order!" is displayed; cart badge shows empty (no count)

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page)

name: Complete checkout with multiple items and verify price arithmetic
description: Validates checkout with a multi-item cart and confirms Item total / Tax (8%) / Total arithmetic on the Overview page per the resolved OQ4 tax rate.
precondition: Fresh login; cart is empty.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`; add Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99) to the cart
test_steps.expected_result: Cart badge shows "2"

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: Both items are listed with quantity 1 each and correct individual prices

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout", fill in valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip, then click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User reaches the Overview page listing both items

test_steps.description: Read the "Item total", "Tax", and "Total" values on the Overview page
test_steps.expected_result: Item total = $39.98 (29.99 + 9.99); Tax = $3.20 (8% of $39.98, rounded); Total = $43.18 (Item total + Tax)

test_steps.description: Click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: Order completes successfully; cart is cleared

name: Cart page displays full item details for each product
description: Confirms each cart line item shows name, description, price, and quantity per AC1.
precondition: Fresh login; cart is empty.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user` and add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart
test_steps.expected_result: Item added; cart badge shows "1"

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: Item name "Sauce Labs Backpack" is visible; item description text is visible; item price "$29.99" is visible; item quantity "1" is visible

name: Cart page offers Continue Shopping and Checkout options
description: Confirms the Cart page exposes both the "continue shopping" and "proceed to checkout" paths required by AC1, and that Continue Shopping preserves cart state.
precondition: Fresh login; cart is empty.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, add any item, and open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: "Continue Shopping" button is visible and enabled; "Checkout" button is visible and enabled

test_steps.description: Click "Continue Shopping"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html`; cart badge count is unchanged (item still in cart)

name: DISCREPANCY: Cart page does not display a total/subtotal price
description: Confirms the live-application gap where the Cart page shows no subtotal/tax/total element, contradicting FR2's requirement to display the total price calculation on the cart page.
precondition: Fresh login; cart is empty.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, add two items with different prices, and open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per FR2/AC1, the Cart page should display the total price calculation for the items in the cart. **Observed (Live Application):** No subtotal, tax, or total price element is present anywhere on `cart.html` — only the two individual item prices are shown. This is a confirmed requirement-vs-implementation gap (FR2), to be flagged for AI Failure Classification / defect triage, not silently skipped.

name: Submitting an entirely empty form shows First Name required error first
description: Confirms mandatory-field enforcement when all three checkout information fields are left empty; validates the field-specific error-priority order.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, add an item, open Cart, click "Checkout" to reach `checkout-step-one.html`
test_steps.expected_result: User is on the Checkout: Your Information page

test_steps.description: Leave all three fields empty and click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: An error alert is shown reading "Error: First Name is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`

name: Leaving only Last Name empty shows Last Name required error
description: Confirms field-specific mandatory validation when only Last Name is left empty.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name only, leave Last Name and Zip empty, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: Last Name is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`

name: Leaving only Zip/Postal Code empty shows Postal Code required error
description: Confirms field-specific mandatory validation when only Zip/Postal Code is left empty.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name and Last Name, leave Zip empty, click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert reads "Error: Postal Code is required"; user remains on `checkout-step-one.html`

name: Valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip proceed to Overview page
description: Confirms the positive path where all three mandatory fields are populated with valid data and the user progresses to the Overview page.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "Jane", Last Name "Smith", Zip "12345", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`; no error alert is shown

name: Error alert can be dismissed via its close control
description: Confirms the required-field error alert's dismiss ("X") control functions correctly and the form remains usable afterward, supporting the "clear feedback" quality referenced in NFR4.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Click "Continue" with all fields empty to trigger the required-field error
test_steps.expected_result: Error alert is visible

test_steps.description: Click the "Dismiss error" (X) control on the alert
test_steps.expected_result: The error alert is no longer visible; the form fields remain empty and editable

name: DISCREPANCY: Special characters in Zip/Postal Code accepted without format validation error
description: Confirms the live-application gap where special-character input in Zip/Postal Code is silently accepted rather than rejected, contradicting AC5's requirement to validate invalid data. Note: exact allowed-format boundaries remain unresolved per Open Question OQ1; this test documents observed behavior against the AC5 intent, not a specific format spec.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name "John", Last Name "Doe", Zip "!@#$%", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per AC5/FR16/FR17, entering invalid data such as special characters should produce a validation error message and block progression. **Observed (Live Application):** No format-validation error is shown; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` despite the non-numeric, special-character Zip value. Confirmed defect against AC5/FR16/FR17.

name: DISCREPANCY: Whitespace-only First Name accepted as valid
description: Confirms the live-application gap where a First Name consisting only of whitespace is accepted as if non-empty, contradicting the mandatory-field intent of FR6/FR7 and the incomplete-data rejection intent of AC5.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter First Name as three spaces "   ", Last Name "Doe", Zip "12345", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per FR6/FR7 (mandatory field enforcement) and AC5 (incomplete information should be rejected), a whitespace-only First Name should be treated as effectively empty and trigger the "First Name is required" error. **Observed (Live Application):** No "First Name is required" error is shown even though the field is effectively blank; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. Confirmed defect against FR6/FR7/AC5.

name: DISCREPANCY: Oversized name input and special-character Last Name both accepted
description: Confirms the live-application gap where there is no maximum-length or allowed-character enforcement on name fields, contradicting the intent of AC5/FR16/FR17. Exact length/character boundaries remain unresolved per OQ1.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter a First Name of 90+ characters, a Last Name containing digits and special characters ("Doe123!@#"), and a valid Zip, then click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per AC5/FR16/FR17, oversized or malformed name input should trigger a length-limit or character-format validation error. **Observed (Live Application):** No length-limit or character-format error is shown for either field; user is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html`. This confirms no max-length or allowed-character validation exists, contradicting the intent of AC5/FR16/FR17.

name: Numeric 5-digit Zip/Postal Code is accepted (happy-path boundary)
description: Confirms a standard, well-formed 5-digit numeric Zip is accepted without error, as a boundary/control case against the discrepancy cases (TC-011–TC-013).
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Enter valid First Name and Last Name, enter Zip "99999", click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-step-two.html` with no errors

name: Overview page lists all cart items with correct details
description: Confirms the Overview page presents a correct, read-only order summary per AC3.
precondition: Fresh login; valid checkout information entered; user is on `checkout-step-two.html`.

test_steps.description: Log in, add Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light to the cart, and proceed through checkout information with valid data to reach `checkout-step-two.html`
test_steps.expected_result: Both items are listed with correct name, quantity (1 each), and price; no "Add to cart" / "Remove" controls are shown on this read-only summary

name: Overview page displays Payment and Shipping information sections
description: Confirms the static Payment and Shipping Information sections required by AC3/FR10 are displayed. Per Assumption A3/Open Question OQ5, this payment information is treated as static demo data, not a user-entered payment form.
precondition: Fresh login; valid checkout information entered; user is on `checkout-step-two.html`.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item in the cart
test_steps.expected_result: "Payment Information:" section shows "SauceCard #31337"; "Shipping Information:" section shows "Free Pony Express Delivery!"

name: Overview page provides Cancel and Finish controls
description: Confirms both required action controls are present and enabled on the Overview page per AC3.
precondition: Fresh login; valid checkout information entered; user is on `checkout-step-two.html`.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item in the cart
test_steps.expected_result: "Cancel" button is visible and enabled; "Finish" button is visible and enabled

name: Finish redirects to confirmation page with success message
description: Confirms clicking Finish completes the order and displays the confirmation content required by AC4.
precondition: Fresh login; user is on `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item.

test_steps.description: Complete checkout information and reach `checkout-step-two.html` with at least one item, then click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/checkout-complete.html`; heading "Thank you for your order!" is displayed; descriptive text about dispatch/delivery is displayed; "Back Home" button is visible

name: Back Home button returns to the Products page
description: Confirms the "Back Home" control on the confirmation page navigates correctly per AC4.
precondition: Fresh login; order just completed; user is on `checkout-complete.html`.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-complete.html` by completing an order
test_steps.expected_result: Confirmation page is displayed

test_steps.description: Click "Back Home"
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page); product grid is displayed

name: Cart is cleared after order confirmation
description: Confirms BR4 (order confirmation clears the cart) by checking both the cart badge and the Cart page content post-completion.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least two items before completing the order.

test_steps.description: Add two items to the cart, complete checkout through "Finish" to reach `checkout-complete.html`
test_steps.expected_result: Cart icon shows no item count badge ("Cart, empty")

test_steps.description: Open the Cart page directly
test_steps.expected_result: Cart page shows zero line items

name: Unauthenticated direct access to checkout is blocked and redirected to login
description: Confirms BR2 (login required for checkout access) is enforced via direct URL navigation, and that the login-gate error message is shown.
precondition: User is logged out (either never logged in this session, or explicitly logged out via the hamburger menu "Logout" link).

test_steps.description: Without logging in (or after explicitly logging out), navigate directly to `https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-one.html`
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page ("/"); an error alert is shown reading: "Epic sadface: You can only access '/checkout-step-one.html' when you are logged in."

name: DISCREPANCY: Checking out with an empty cart is not blocked and can be completed with a $0.00 total
description: Confirms the live-application gap where BR3/FR19 (cart cannot be empty when proceeding to checkout) is not enforced, allowing a full end-to-end order with zero items and a $0.00 total.
precondition: Fresh login with a guaranteed-empty cart (immediately after logging in, or after completing/clearing a prior order).

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user` with a guaranteed-empty cart, open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per BR3/FR19, the "Checkout" button should not be present, should be disabled, or should be blocked with an empty-cart message when the cart has zero items. **Observed (Live Application):** "Checkout" button is present and enabled even though the cart has zero items.

test_steps.description: Click "Checkout"
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** User should be blocked from proceeding. **Observed (Live Application):** User is unexpectedly redirected to `/checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Fill in valid First Name, Last Name, and Zip, then click "Continue"
test_steps.expected_result: **Observed (Live Application):** User reaches `/checkout-step-two.html` showing "Item total: $0", "Tax: $0.00", "Total: $0.00", and no line items.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish"
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** An order with zero items should never be able to complete, per BR3/FR19. **Observed (Live Application):** Order completes successfully and `/checkout-complete.html` is shown, confirming an order with zero items was allowed end-to-end. Confirmed defect against BR3/FR19 — flag for downstream AI Failure Classification as an application/business-logic defect.

name: Logged-in session persists across checkout steps for a valid multi-step flow
description: Confirms the user's authenticated session is not lost or challenged again at any point during a normal checkout flow.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least one item.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, add an item, and progress through Cart -> Checkout Info -> Overview -> Complete without logging out
test_steps.expected_result: No re-authentication is required at any step; each page transition succeeds without redirect to login

name: DISCREPANCY: Attempting to check out again immediately after order completion reproduces the empty-cart defect
description: Confirms the BR3/FR19 gap identified in TC-022 also reproduces immediately after a legitimate order completion leaves the cart empty, rather than being a one-off/edge condition.
precondition: An order has just been completed for one item, leaving the cart empty.

test_steps.description: Complete a full order for one item so the cart becomes empty, then click "Checkout" again from the now-empty cart page
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per BR3/FR19, the application should show a "cart is empty" guard message and prevent navigation to checkout-step-one.html. **Observed (Live Application):** The application again allows navigation to `checkout-step-one.html` despite zero items, reproducing the BR3/FR19 gap rather than showing any guard message.

name: Cancel from Checkout Information page returns to Cart page with items preserved
description: Confirms BR5 (cancel at any step, return to cart) for the checkout information (step-one) page, and confirms cart contents are preserved (OQ9 area).
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least two items; user is on `checkout-step-one.html`.

test_steps.description: Log in, add two items to the cart, click "Checkout" to reach `checkout-step-one.html`
test_steps.expected_result: User is on the Checkout: Your Information page

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel" on the Checkout Information page
test_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to `/cart.html` (Your Cart); both items are still present in the cart with correct quantities and prices

name: DISCREPANCY: Cancel from Checkout Overview page returns to Products page, not the Cart page
description: Confirms the asymmetry between the two Cancel controls: step-one Cancel returns to the cart (TC-025), but step-two (Overview) Cancel returns to the Products page instead, which is inconsistent with the implied "return to cart" behavior in BR5. Cart preservation itself is unaffected.
precondition: Fresh login; cart has at least two items; valid checkout information entered; user is on `checkout-step-two.html`.

test_steps.description: Log in, add two items to the cart, proceed through valid checkout information to reach `checkout-step-two.html`
test_steps.expected_result: User is on the Checkout: Overview page

test_steps.description: Click "Cancel" on the Checkout Overview page
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per BR5's "return to cart" intent (and for consistency with the step-one Cancel behavior in TC-025), Cancel should return the user to `/cart.html`. **Observed (Live Application):** User is redirected to `/inventory.html` (Products page), NOT `/cart.html` — inconsistent with the step-one Cancel destination. Cart badge still shows the original item count, confirming cart contents are preserved even though the landing page differs. Confirmed inconsistency against BR5, flagged for defect triage.

name: DISCREPANCY: Browser back button after order confirmation shows a stale Overview page whose Finish button is still clickable
description: Confirms there is no safeguard preventing re-submission/re-navigation to a completed order via the browser Back button, which risks appearing to duplicate a "Finish" action against an already-cleared cart.
precondition: An order has just been completed for one item; user is on `checkout-complete.html`.

test_steps.description: Complete a full order for one item to reach `checkout-complete.html`
test_steps.expected_result: Confirmation page is displayed

test_steps.description: Click the browser Back button
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** No documented expectation exists for this action (OQ6 was open); at minimum BR4 implies the cart should remain cleared and no further order actions should be possible without re-adding items. **Observed (Live Application):** Browser navigates to `/checkout-step-two.html` showing an empty/zero-value order summary (cart already cleared); "Finish" button is still present and enabled.

test_steps.description: Click "Finish" again
test_steps.expected_result: **Observed (Live Application):** User is redirected back to `/checkout-complete.html` without any error, confirming no safeguard exists against re-submitting/re-visiting a completed order via back navigation. Flagged as a defect-candidate for triage given the absence of a resubmission guard.

name: Full checkout flow renders and completes at a mobile viewport (375x667)
description: Confirms the entire checkout flow is usable at a representative mobile viewport, per NFR2's mobile-responsiveness requirement. Exact breakpoints/devices remain unresolved per OQ8; 375x667 is used as the specific viewport already specified in the approved Structured Test Plan.
precondition: Fresh login; viewport set to 375x667 (e.g., iPhone SE dimensions) before login.

test_steps.description: Set the browser viewport to 375x667, log in as `standard_user`
test_steps.expected_result: Login form and hamburger menu icon render without horizontal overflow

test_steps.description: Add an item to the cart and proceed through Cart -> Checkout Info -> Overview -> Complete at this viewport
test_steps.expected_result: All buttons and form fields remain visible, tappable, and functional at each step; no layout element is clipped or overlapping such that a user could not complete checkout

name: All checkout-flow validation and success messages are captured verbatim for content review
description: Consolidates the exact text of every checkout-flow validation and success message for a single content-accuracy review pass, per NFR5's requirement that all validation messages be validated as part of testing.
precondition: Fresh login; access to checkout-step-one.html and checkout-complete.html.

test_steps.description: Trigger each of: First Name required, Last Name required, Postal Code required, and the order-confirmation success message, capturing the exact text of each
test_steps.expected_result: Message text is exactly: "Error: First Name is required"; "Error: Last Name is required"; "Error: Postal Code is required"; "Thank you for your order!" success heading on `checkout-complete.html`. All messages are recorded verbatim in test evidence per NFR5.

name: DISCREPANCY: Undocumented "Generate PDF order" button appears on the confirmation page
description: Confirms and records the presence of a "Generate PDF order" control on the order confirmation page that is not referenced anywhere in FR13–FR15 or AC4, so that its existence is visible to product/requirements owners rather than silently observed and dropped. This test case does not assert pass/fail against any requirement — none exists to test against — it only confirms the control's presence and that clicking it does not break the documented AC4 flow.
precondition: An order has just been completed; user is on `checkout-complete.html`.

test_steps.description: Reach `checkout-complete.html` by completing an order
test_steps.expected_result: **Per Requirement (Expected):** Per AC4/FR13–FR15, only a "Back Home" button is documented on the confirmation page. **Observed (Live Application):** An additional "Generate PDF order" button is also present, which is not documented anywhere in the Requirement Analysis Report's functional requirements.

test_steps.description: Click "Generate PDF order"
test_steps.expected_result: Confirm the click does not error out or block the documented "Back Home" control from still functioning; record actual behavior (e.g., file download, new tab, no-op) as an evidence note for product-owner review, since no documented expected behavior exists for this control.

name: DISCREPANCY: No quantity-selector control exists anywhere in the product/cart UI
description: Confirms that the product catalog and cart offer no quantity-selector or stepper control, meaning each product can only be added as a single unit per line item. This confirms the "varying quantities" edge case in the Requirement Analysis Report's Edge Cases section is not achievable through the current UI, and documents this as a UI/functionality gap rather than a test-design omission.
precondition: Fresh login.

test_steps.description: Log in as `standard_user`, view a product's detail page and the inventory grid
test_steps.expected_result: No quantity input, stepper, or "+/-" control is present anywhere alongside "Add to cart"

test_steps.description: Add the product to the cart and open the Cart page
test_steps.expected_result: Cart line item quantity is fixed at "1" with no control to increase or decrease it. **Per Requirement (Expected):** The Report's Edge Cases section anticipates verifying "varying quantities" arithmetic. **Observed (Live Application):** No UI path exists to create a quantity greater than 1 for a single line item, so that edge case cannot be executed as originally anticipated — confirmed as a scope limitation, not a defect against any specific FR.

name: Cross-browser regression of the full checkout happy path (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
description: Re-executes the TC-001 happy-path checkout flow on each of the three browsers named in NFR1, to confirm cross-browser compatibility of the checkout flow. This reuses the already-documented TC-001 flow; it does not introduce new functionality, only a new execution environment per browser.
precondition: Fresh login; cart is empty; test executed once per browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari).

test_steps.description: Repeat the TC-001 full checkout flow (login -> add to cart -> cart -> checkout info -> overview -> finish -> back home) in Chrome
test_steps.expected_result: All TC-001 expected results hold identically in Chrome

test_steps.description: Repeat the same flow in Firefox
test_steps.expected_result: All TC-001 expected results hold identically in Firefox

test_steps.description: Repeat the same flow in Safari (or WebKit-based equivalent)
test_steps.expected_result: All TC-001 expected results hold identically in Safari; any browser-specific rendering or functional deviation is recorded as a defect candidate

name: Exploratory observation of checkout "security" controls
description: Records observable, checkable security-adjacent facts about the checkout flow (e.g., use of HTTPS, whether any sensitive-looking field values are echoed insecurely) without asserting pass/fail against a threshold, since NFR3 provides no concrete, testable security requirement and OQ3 remains unresolved.
precondition: Fresh login; access to the full checkout flow.

test_steps.description: Observe the protocol/scheme used to load every checkout-flow page (login, inventory, cart, checkout-step-one, checkout-step-two, checkout-complete)
test_steps.expected_result: Record whether HTTPS is used consistently; this is an observation, not a pass/fail assertion, since no concrete security control is documented (NFR3, OQ3)

test_steps.description: Observe whether the checkout information fields (First Name, Last Name, Zip) are transmitted or rendered in any obviously insecure way (e.g., visible in plaintext URL parameters)
test_steps.expected_result: Record findings for product-owner review; flag any concerning observation as a candidate for a future, concretely-scoped security requirement rather than a confirmed defect against an undocumented standard

name: Exploratory observation of checkout "intuitiveness" and step-by-step feedback clarity
description: Records observable usability/feedback-clarity findings across the checkout flow (e.g., whether each step communicates its outcome clearly) without asserting pass/fail against a measurable threshold, since NFR4 is stated qualitatively with no defined acceptance criterion.
precondition: Fresh login; access to the full checkout flow.

test_steps.description: Walk through Cart -> Checkout Info -> Overview -> Complete, noting whether each transition provides clear on-screen feedback of what just happened and what to do next
test_steps.expected_result: Record observations (e.g., error alert clarity, absence of a subtotal on the cart page per TC-005, Cancel-destination asymmetry per TC-026) as qualitative findings for product-owner review, not as pass/fail defects against a measurable NFR4 threshold
